title: fix(changeset): close the 26095 publishing-metadata changeset's frontmatter so `changeset version` parses again
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9WV2t4SJjcpQk4Wkqfp7kPN)_

Release blocker for 18.2.0. No card: the maintainer asked for it directly in the project thread ("阻塞项你现在优先解决", 2026-10-27 04:16Z).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`.changeset/26095-publishing-metadata.md` 第 74 行 `'create-objectstack': patch---` 拆成 `patch` 和 `---` 两行。没有改任何包名、bump 级别或正文。
- 为什么改：frontmatter 一直没有闭合，`@changesets/parse` 抛出 "missing or invalid frontmatter"，`changeset version` 直接失败。从 10-26 18:14Z 起，定时的 Version PR maintenance 两次都红在这里，所以 #25640 一直停在 `d1ea2363`。
- 风险与回滚：只改一个换行。回滚就是 revert，`changeset version` 会重新失败。
- **Check Changeset 会保持红色，这是预期的。** 这个 PR 改了一个不是它自己加的 changeset，属于 #17712 说的 DELIBERATE CORRECTION 类，处理方式见下文。

## What changes

`.changeset/26095-publishing-metadata.md` (added by #26198): on line 74 the closing `---` of the frontmatter was glued to the last release line. This PR splits that line so the frontmatter closes. The diff is one line in, two lines out.

## Why

`changeset version` reads every pending changeset. This file threw, so the whole command exited 1. Run 40426048088 (00:23Z) shows it in its Version PR maintenance job:

```
could not parse changeset - missing or invalid frontmatter.
  at parseChangesetFile (@changesets/parse@1.0.0 ...)
```

Run 40375928411 (10-26 18:14Z) is the earlier red. The 13:36Z run, before #26198, was green.

## Pending release note correction (#17712, DELIBERATE CORRECTION)

This PR changes `.changeset/26095-publishing-metadata.md`, a pending release note it did not add. The correction leaves the note's meaning alone: the same 73 `patch` lines and the same body, with only the missing line break restored. Restoring the base text would put the parse failure back. Per the `pr-automation.yml` route 0 text, no `skip-changeset` label is applied, and **Check Changeset is left red**. That check is not a required context. Confirmation: the maintainer's request quoted above.

## Verification

- Ran `@changesets/parse` 1.0.0 (the version CI resolves) over every `.changeset/*.md`. Before this PR, 1 of 225 failed, and it was this file. After this PR, 0 of 225 fail.
- `changeset version` (`@changesets/cli` 3.0.3) on a scratch worktree of this head: result is in the comment below.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (none added)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (this PR publishes nothing of its own; it repairs an existing changeset)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
